text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAAHHH!!!! Time to patrol the 
academy with full-on passion, su!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's because it's my birthday, boss! A 
fresh start, so I wanna work even harder 
than usual!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's so like you, Bamboo. Mind if 
I help with the patrol?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, count me in too! And let's party 
afterwards! We're definitely celebrating, 
no matter what☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. We'll definitely throw 
the birthday party once it's all over, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, helping out, and even a 
party...ufffc!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"You're way too kind...! It's blindingly 
bright! All I can do is give it my 
absolute best to thank you for your 
goodwill! Uooooooooohhhhh!!"
